slots.headline: The Songwriters Festival reaches Milton, and Bethany opens its arts weekend
slots.note: Dogfish Head's Milton Brewery hosts a writers-round happy hour from 4 to 6; in Bethany, Gallery One's Meet the Artists reception runs 5 to 7, the evening before the boardwalk fills with tents.

slots.headline: Paid parking still runs through Tuesday in the beach towns
slots.note: Rehoboth, Dewey, Bethany and Fenwick all charge through September 15. Lewes meters run to October 14.

slots.headline: A hundred juried artists on the Bethany boardwalk, 10 to 4
slots.note: The 48th Boardwalk Arts Festival covers the boardwalk, the bandstand and the downtown streets. It is inside Bethany's paid-parking season.

slots.headline: Writers rounds in Milton, then the festival afterparty
slots.note: Two writers rounds at the Milton Brewery, Adam Weiner at The Room at Cedar Grove, and an afterparty at The Coastal Tap Room.

slots.headline: Nassau Valley's Sunday market, noon to 3
slots.note: Produce, crafts and live music at the vineyard — one of the markets that runs well past Labor Day, into mid-October.
